# Camera contributions by masking (Stage 5.5 C4; generated by `vl.camera_contrib --report`)

Per val frame: |V_full − V_masked| when one camera is removed (`drop` = its token masked out of the readout attention, attention runs only; `mean` = its features replaced by their val mean). wrist share = wrist / (wrist + side) contribution, averaged over frames. ΔCE = CE with the camera removed − full CE (how much the val loss depends on it). Mean over the arm's seeds; ± = seed sd. Readout attention (C3, last block, mean over heads) shown next to it where it exists.
